description: Compare two committed revisions, for example a branch against main, and report changes that weaken tests, assertions, coverage thresholds, lint rules or CI. The rules come from the base revision, so the change under review cannot switch them off. Read-only and offline.

base.description: The revision to compare against, for example main or origin/main.

head.description: The revision under review. Defaults to HEAD.

path.description: A directory inside the project. Defaults to the project the server was started in.

name: review_changes
title: Review a range of commits
